source.title: Jungle Durian
source.objective:
ProgressThe bold and pungent smelling fruit will keep your spirits high while you traverse through the Swamp of Sorrows and explore the Temple of Atal'Hakkar. Don't let the odor fool you mon, this is a prized fruit of my people!

If you bring me back something enticing from your adventures, I'll make it worth your while, mon. A bundle of our finest durian for your troubles! Shall we make a deal?
source.completion: Taz'dingo! Enjoy the delicious, sweet durian, but remember mon... no refunds.
